final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), film_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total FROM film_actor), actor_values AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, 1.0 * film_count / total AS film_share FROM actor_counts CROSS JOIN film_total) SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_share, film_share - AVG(film_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM actor_values ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, actor_id LIMIT 10
